title: Backfill catalog file, raw contract 2.4.0
description: One per run captured before 2.1.0, plus the ported history run, under raw/{source}/_catalog/backfill/{run_id}.json (#63 D8). Written once, never overwritten. Each captures[] entry carries the manifest's captures[] fields, so a consumer can union the two, plus where its shape verdict came from. Strict at every level: a field not listed here is a contract change.

captures.description: One entry per payload in the run, each exactly once.

key.description: Full object key under the bucket, no scheme. history/ for the ported season.

received_at.description: From the sidecar; for the history run, the synthetic run's instant (#63 D5).

http_status.description: null only where the capture never recorded one: the history run (#63 D5).

usable.description: Written and shape_ok. Every entry was written, so this equals shape_ok.

season.description: From this run's bootstrap-static; null when the run had no usable one (#63 D6).

validator_version.description: null when the sidecar's verdict was used; fpl-ingest/<version>+<sha7> when revalidated (#63 D7).
